fields.Name: T205 - System Diagnostics Performance Sub-Tab Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the L3 perfTab navigation (setPerfTab / @if perfTab) nested inside the Performance section — a separate tier of navigation from the L2 section tabs.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the Admin application, open 'Monitoring', select System Diagnostics, then click the 'Performance' section tab. Inside the Performance panel there is a secondary sub-tab strip: Monitor, Overview, Events, Patterns, Insights. Click through these sub-tabs and confirm the content area below swaps for each (e.g. the Monitor chart, the Overview summary cards, the Events timeline, the Patterns table, the Insights list — each may show its own empty-state if telemetry has no data). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing each sub-tab's distinct content (or valid empty-state) render is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Performance section shows a sub-tab strip with Monitor, Overview, Events, Patterns, and Insights
Clicking each sub-tab swaps the content below to that tab's distinct view (chart / summary cards / timeline / patterns table / insights), or a valid empty-state when no telemetry data exists
The active sub-tab is visually indicated
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
